inputs.global_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the photograph shown in <Picture 1>, treated as a thin physical photo card standing in space. The printed image, its tones and grain, and the person or subject in it remain unchanged.
<Picture 1> is the first-frame viewpoint of [Shot 1].

summary:
[reference generation] ORB360_CARDSPIN. The photograph from <Picture 1> turns as a thin physical card in front of a dark background: one full clockwise turn in 5.125000 seconds, while the portrait inside it reveals the side and the back of the sitter's head.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the photograph's printed image, tones and grain, and the person or subject in it are retained; only the card's orientation in space changes.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame and last frame): fully_preserved - the shot starts and ends exactly on this view.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] The shot begins exactly on <Picture 1>. The camera makes one smooth clockwise 360-degree turn around the photograph, which behaves like a thin card. The printed portrait swings with the card: the sitter's face turns away into profile, the card goes edge-on as a thin vertical sliver with the nose and profile sticking out past its edge, then the back of the card shows the back of the sitter's head and hair, then the opposite profile passes through layered over the back of the head, and the front of the photograph returns. The dark background and the card's dark edge show at the sides while it turns. No cuts, no zoom.

The video runs at 24 fps and has 124 frames; the full turn takes 5.125000 seconds (frame 0 to frame 123).
At 0.000000 seconds (zero-based frame 0), the view is exactly <Picture 1>, the front of the photograph.
At 1.000000 seconds (zero-based frame 24), the card is edge-on: a thin vertical sliver showing the sitter's right-facing profile, the nose sticking out past the edge.
At 1.708333 seconds (zero-based frame 41), the back of the card faces the camera, showing the back of the sitter's head and hair.
At 3.416667 seconds (zero-based frame 82), the back of the head still faces the camera as the card keeps turning.
At 3.833333 seconds (zero-based frame 92), the opposite, left-facing profile passes through, layered over the back of the head.
At 5.125000 seconds (zero-based frame 123), the view has returned exactly to <Picture 1>.

N/A
